title: Replace logos in translated images
summary: Swap a detected logo in the Image Translator for one from your library, an upload or Drive, then move and resize it by hand.

sections.title: Logo replacement in the Image Translator

items.title: Replace a detected logo.
items.body: Pick a replacement from your organization's logo library, upload one, or browse Drive. A preview shows how it fits the original's spot, and warns if it is too low-resolution or the wrong shape, before you spend credits.

items.title: Move and resize it by hand.
items.body: The new logo starts where the old one was. Drag or scale it to adjust; it never stretches, and **Reset** puts it back.
